note: Fixture for journey J6 (the notch) and the slice-6 checks. Fictional people and domains. The core's fixture verb `fixture deliver <name> <this file> [idle|eventsource]` reads an arrival from `arrivals`; ids, text and the code are the expected values the checks compare to, never read from a built screen. The perf-idle and perf-eventsource arrivals belong to perf/notch-arrival.py: one per mode, so each mode has its own empty baseline.
